cdxgen.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. Invoked through the pinned image ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:12.8.2, so it needs no build root and runs the same on any host with Docker.

pqprobe-static.version: pqprobe-static 3.8.1 (commit unknown, built unknown, dirty unknown)
pqprobe-static.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. The binary path comes from PQPROBE_STATIC_BIN; the manifest records what it resolved to and that file's sha256. Maintained by the same party as Proofstein; see the governance section in README.md.

cryptoscan.notes: Defaults. Withholds findings it classes as quantum-safe (AES, SHA-2). Exits 1 when a critical finding is present, after writing the full report (internal/cli/scan.go at v1.4.0).

cryptoscan-quantum-safe.notes: --include-quantum-safe: also reports AES and SHA-2. Exits 1 when a critical finding is present, after writing the full report (internal/cli/scan.go at v1.4.0).

cbomkit-theia.notes: Default plugins. Reads certificates, keys, java.security and OpenSSL configuration; no source code.

opengrep.package_version: opengrep 1.30.1 with the 100 cryptography rules (harness/select_rules.py, by CWE) of opengrep-rules at f1d2b562, rule content of 0f5a85ce (2024-12-13); rule set sha256/16 58291c511806239d
opengrep.notes: Each result is a component named by its rule id, at the reported file and line.

codeql.package_version: CodeQL bundle 2.27.1 (checksum verified), inventory queries only
